name: Torre del Greco (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Torre del Greco (a tower before Vesuvius) within branches, with the motto POST FATA RESURGO on a scroll beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Torre del Greco, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Torre del Greco arms — tower before Vesuvius, crowned, within branches, with motto POST FATA RESURGO
